lead: A side drawer. Focus trapping, Esc to close, swipe to close and background scroll lock come from Base UI's Drawer; the backdrop and close button reuse the slots of [Dialog](/dialog).

api.title: API Reference
api.parts: `Drawer.Title` / `Description` / `Body` / `Footer` / `Close` are the [Dialog](/dialog) parts of the same name.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `drawer.css`. As with every overlay, `data-skein-theme` must be set on `<html>`.
styling.dialog: The backdrop and the close button, shared with Dialog
styling.drawer: The fixed layer, the drawer itself (`data-side` / `data-size`) and the content layer
styling.states: Entering, leaving and swiping; the offset comes from `--drawer-swipe-movement-x` / `y`
